ownerStatement: Release Temp Save 0.1.1-experimental. I waive the static cycle bound for this version.
reason: 0.1.1 changes only how the reload reaches FUNC + CUE's seven refresh routines (a loop over their addresses) and how it marks the bank unsaved, so the USB package no longer repeats stock's instruction bytes (#1391). Temp Save works once per FUNC + YES or FUNC + NO press, in the UI task and outside the audio frame; 0.1.0's dearest event, a reload while playing, measured 640,923 executed instructions in the emulator against a 26,600,000 budget, and 0.1.1 adds at most 28. No static count was made. Every other qualification stays required.
